method: Per object: evaluated mesh in saved world coordinates; Blender triangle BVH compares distinct polygons with no shared triangle vertex. Winding and edge/manifold tests use BMesh. Degenerate testing uses double-area < 1e-12 square metres. Surface lettering is reported with its exact native type and counts. The shell is fingerprinted twice, using saved topology, world/local positions, all UVs, inside/outside colour, sharpness/smoothing, landmark groups, material indices and shader graph.
scope: Geometry, presence and material readback. This does not measure mechanical tolerances or gas/seal performance, prove all inter-part contacts, or test Unity/VR.
